title: 第11章 二品炼丹师第12章 匹夫无罪怀璧其罪
slug: 合欢宗从照顾师弟道侣开始修仙
content_zh:
“师兄，您可有什么心愿未了之事？师妹要是能够做到定帮您完成心愿！”
袁宝宝深知自己修为浅薄。
资质也不是很好。
筑基有望，但结丹是一道难以跨越的天堑。
她能够为师兄做的事情极为有限。
李蒙上下打量着袁宝宝。
袁宝宝在一众女弟子中虽然谈不上惊艳。
但也有着上等之姿。
李蒙笑眯眯摸着袁宝宝的小手。
“哎，或许是因为大限将至的原因，师兄这几日甚感孤寂，不知师妹能否陪伴师兄几日？”
袁宝宝一脸疑惑的看着李师兄。
李师兄这话是什么意思。
袁宝宝低头一看，脸色微红。
李师兄正摸着她的手呢。
袁宝宝这才意识到李师兄话中的意思。
“师兄，您……您怎能如此轻薄师妹？”
袁宝宝抽回了手。
把储物袋塞进了李蒙手中。
然后红着脸逃也似的向外跑去。
李蒙手中不知何时拿着一张缩地符。

下一刻，李蒙凭空消失了。
下一瞬间又出现在了门口。
“师兄，您……您让开！”
袁宝宝觉得自己的脸颊有些发烫。
她没想到半只脚踏进棺材的李师兄竟然打她的主意。
虽然她很喜欢李师兄。
但那种喜欢不涉及情爱。
“师妹莫恼，师妹不愿，师兄又怎会强迫师妹呢！”
李蒙向前两步把储物袋塞进了袁宝宝手中。
“去吧，可别死在师兄前面，不然师兄可就真要死不瞑目了！”
袁宝宝低头看着手中的储物袋默然无语。
她抬头神情复杂的看着一脸慈蔼的李师兄。
袁宝宝作揖行礼。
“师兄之恩，师妹不会忘记的！”
袁宝宝收下了储物袋。
从李蒙身旁走过，打开房门走了出去。
一股香风扑鼻，李蒙面露陶醉之色。
李蒙笑了笑，摇着头向书桌走去。
身后的房“嘭”的一声关上了。
虽然失败了，但李蒙也没有太过在意。

他要的只是袁师妹的好感度而已。
袁师妹的好感度没有降低。
content_en:
"Senior brother, do you have any unfulfilled wishes? If junior sister can do it, I will help you fulfill your wish!"
Yuan Baobao knows very well that his cultivation is shallow.
The qualifications are not very good either.
There is hope for foundation building, but forming a core is an insurmountable chasm.
What she can do for her senior brother is extremely limited.
Li Meng looked Yuan Baobao up and down.
Although Yuan Baobao is not amazing among the female disciples.
But it also has a classy appearance.
Li Meng smiled and touched Yuan Baobao's little hand.
"Hey, maybe it's because the deadline is approaching. Senior brother has been feeling very lonely these days. I wonder if junior sister can stay with senior brother for a few days?"
Yuan Baobao looked at Senior Brother Li with a puzzled look.
What does Senior Brother Li mean by this?
Yuan Baobao looked down and his face turned slightly red.
Senior Brother Li was touching her hand.
Only then did Yuan Baobao realize the meaning of Senior Brother Li's words.
"Senior Brother, you...how can you be so frivolous towards Junior Sister?"
Yuan Baobao withdrew his hand.
He stuffed the storage bag into Li Meng's hand.
Then he ran out with a red face and seemed to be running away.
Li Meng didn't know when he was holding a shrinking talisman in his hand.
The next moment, Li Meng disappeared out of thin air.
The next moment he appeared at the door again.
"Brother, you...get out of the way!"
Yuan Baobao felt that his cheeks were a little hot.
She didn't expect that Senior Brother Li, who had half his foot in the coffin, would have an idea for her.
Although she likes Senior Brother Li very much.
But that kind of liking doesn't involve love.
"Junior sister, don't be upset. If the junior sister doesn't want to, how can the senior brother force the junior sister!"
Li Meng took two steps forward and stuffed the storage bag into Yuan Baobao's hands.
"Go, don't die in front of senior brother, otherwise senior brother will really die with his eyes open!"
Yuan Baobao looked down at the storage bag in his hand and was speechless.
She raised her head and looked at Senior Brother Li with a complicated expression.
Yuan Baobao bowed and saluted.
"Senior Brother's kindness will never be forgotten by Junior Sister!"
Yuan Baobao accepted the storage bag.
He walked past Li Meng, opened the door and walked out.
A scent of fragrant wind hit his nostrils, and Li Meng looked intoxicated.
Li Meng smiled, shook his head and walked towards the desk.
The room behind him closed with a bang.
Although he failed, Li Meng didn't care too much.
All he wants is Junior Sister Yuan's favorability.
Junior Sister Yuan's favorability has not decreased.
